name: jin10-mcp-terminal
description: 实时财经终端 — 通过标准 MCP 协议接入金十数据

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test
scripts.matrix:sync: npm run build --workspace server && node server/dist/matrix/cli.js
scripts.matrix:stats: npm run build --workspace server && node server/dist/matrix/cli.js --stats
scripts.matrix:reindex: npm run build --workspace server && node server/dist/matrix/cli.js --reindex --stats
